name: timbermaw_hold
notes: DRAFT: prepared offline from the world database export of map 819 (tools/dungeongen/testdata/map819) and the server mesh; not mapped, not live-checked. The mapping walk (B2) corrects the route before the first run: dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

Turtle custom raid, no instance script in the core and no EventAI or spell list on any boss but Loktanag the Vile: the encounters are not implemented in this core yet (the Timbermaw migration of 2026-07-02 says combat initialization is missing). Karrsh the Sentinel, Rotgrowl and Kodiak have attackable bodies and no mechanics.

Ursol (62947) and Peroth'arn (60686) have creature templates but no spawn row on map 819; the final boss area (the z 310-364 balcony behind the Barrier of Ursol 300606) has no navmesh route from the rest of the map. They are not legs.
The 62874 Vile Skitterer spawns are neutral wildlife (faction template 15, hostile_mask 0, level 55, 6101 hp) and are in every leg's skip list, not in pulls.
Bosses that are not in the hire unlock list (Karrsh 62934, Selenaxx 62940) still get a boss step: the run leader treats them as a boss fight, the kill credit table does not count them.
